description: Default capability set for Zoc AI: sidecar shell, scoped FS, dialog, and the application's own commands for secrets / patch / workspace / Agent_Runtime. This is a real allowlist rather than documentation — build.rs declares the app ACL manifest, so a command absent from the allow-* list below is registered in Rust and unreachable from the webview. Two deliberate omissions, both R14.2 credential reads the renderer must never be able to call: runtime_secret_get, the runtime-facing path, omitted since it was written; and secret_get, revoked at task 26.3 once the three renderer callers that read a plaintext key were repointed. The order mattered — revoking first would have sent secret_get's vault-unavailable fallback to the localStorage shadow, reading plaintext out of renderer storage while this file looked correct. The renderer keeps secret_set / secret_clear / secret_has: it may write, remove, and ask whether a key exists, never read one. The Agent_Runtime endpoint handoff (R3.4) and the hardware-fit probe (R13.6) are granted here; the probe reads hardware only and carries no secret, so it is not a trust-boundary grant.
